title: Delay
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Operations/Delay.md
text: Delay input signal by fixed or variable sample periods, 5 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {External reset} sets External state reset; {Delay length}, {Initial condition}, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Use circular buffer for state} sets the circular buffer for storing state, {Prevent direct feedthrough}, {Remove delay length check in generated code} sets the remove delay length out-of-range check, {Diagnostic for delay length} sets the diagnostic checks for delay length, {Show enable port} sets the create enable port, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the discrete interval between sample time hits, {State name} sets the unique name for block state and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} requires state name resolve to a signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Use circular buffer for state
params.values: Circular buffer for storing state off (default) | on

params.values: Remove delay length out-of-range check off (default) | on

params.values: Diagnostic checks for delay length None (default) | Warning | Error

params.name: External reset
params.values: External state reset None (default) | Rising | Falling | Either | Level | Level hold

params.values: Unique name for block state ’’ (default) | alphanumeric string
